Help [[Imperial Agent Hanjo]] find a cure for the plague by finding the [[Am Fah]]'s source of immunity.

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Speak with [[Bujo]].
* Collect [3...0] more [[Jade Brotherhood Guild Cape|Jade Brotherhood guild cape]][s].
* Return the 3 [[Jade Brotherhood]] guild capes to Bujo.

=== Reward ===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 175 [[Gold]]

===Environmental changes===
* After accepting the quest reward, all the Am Fah in [[Wajjun Bazaar]] will be [[Ally|allies]] until you take either [[Refuse to Drink]] or [[Drink from the Chalice of Corruption]]. This also means that they will not ambush parties out near the areas closer to [[Nahpui Quarter (outpost)|Nahpui Quarter]]. Because of this, it may be advantageous to hold off on completing this until you finish your quests in [[The Undercity]] and/or [[Vanquisher|vanquish]] Wajjun Bazaar. The exceptions to this are the quests [[Captured]], [[The Xunlai Agent]], [[Deactivating P.O.X.]], and [[Street Justice]].  The Am Fah in the immediate area will still be hostile.

== Walkthrough ==
Simply map travel to [[The Marketplace]] and exit through the Wajjun Bazaar portal. Kill the 3 [[Jade Brotherhood Knight]]s immediately outside and pick up the Jade Brotherhood Guild Capes. Map travel back to Kaineng Center to receive your reward.

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; Imperial Agent Hanjo
: ''"I have heard of your assistance to the empire, <Character name>, and I had hoped you would come to see me.  You see, the emperor has charged me with finding a cure for the plague, and I do not plan on disappointing him.  There are rumors that members of a local guild known as the Am Fah have exhibited an unusual resistance to the plague, and it is my belief that they have developed some sort of cure.  This is where you come in.  I need someone to infiltrate Am Fah's ranks and learn the source of their immunity.  Since you are an outsider, you may be the only one who can do this without raising suspicions.  In '''[[Kaineng Center]]''' you will find a man named '''Bujo''', a known Am Fah associate.  Speak with him and learn what you can."''
{{offer dialog
| accept = I'll speak to Bujo.
| decline = Reconnaissance isn't really my thing.
| ask = Speak to '''Bujo''' in the main '''Kaineng Center'''.  He can tell you how to join the Am Fah. 
}}

=== Intermediate dialogue ===
; Bujo
: ''"You wish to join Am Fah?  Well, we are always looking for new members, and you look to be a strong one.... We of the Am Fah can show you a way to strengthen both the body and the mind ,but first, you must prove yourself.  No reason to look worried, it is quite simple.  All you must remember is that the enemy of our enemy is our friend.  Go and slay 3 of those accursed Jade Brotherhood and bring me their guild capes as proof.  Then we shall speak of true strength."''

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Bujo
: ''"Impressive.... You have proven yourself a friend of Am Fah."''

== Notes ==
* The quest marker will point you to the island at Wajjun Bazaar.
* Players who complete this quest will ''not'' be able to capture [[Quivering Blade]] until the rest of the quest chain is complete, since [[Sun, the Quivering]] won't spawn.
